description: Block-level frequency summary for one candidate. Reports the H1 allele frequency, the three karyotype-class counts (H1H1 / H1H2 / H2H2), HWE expected counts and chi-square, the HWE_FIS inbreeding coefficient, and a coarse polymorphism class. Named frequency_block to avoid clashing with frequency.v3.schema.json (the older v2 SV-frequency block).
question: Q6
source_script: harvest_candidates.py reads karyotype_groups.tsv and computes the chi-square + FIS in pure stdlib (math.erfc for the 1-df p-value).

n_total.description: Total samples with a karyotype call.

HWE_FIS.description: Inbreeding coefficient 1 - H_obs/H_exp. Negative = heterozygote excess (consistent with overdominance or sheltered load).
